# lancha boat (La Lancha Charters)

> Private boat charters and crewed boat experiences in Chicago aboard Quarters, a boat docked at Diversey Harbor on Lake Michigan. Also known as La Lancha Charters. Owned and operated by Captain Luis G. Vecchio. Website: https://lanchaboat.com. Instagram: @lanchaboats.

## Key facts
- Boat: Quarters, Diversey Harbor, K-Dock, Slip 8, Lincoln Park, Chicago, IL.
- Capacity: up to 12 guests on a bareboat charter.
- Booking: request online at https://lanchaboat.com/book or https://lanchaboat.com/experiences. Every request is reviewed and confirmed personally, usually the same day. Nothing is charged until it is confirmed; payment is by invoice.
- Contact: lalanchacharters@gmail.com
- Guests bring their own food and drinks.
- Waivers are signed at the dock before boarding.

## Bareboat charters (you charter the boat)
- Three four-hour blocks a day: Morning 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM, Afternoon 2:30 PM to 6:30 PM, Night 7:00 PM to 11:00 PM.
- Standard price is listed per block on the booking page; some dates are priced higher.
- A U.S. Coast Guard-licensed captain is required. lancha boat keeps a roster of captains who know Quarters (typically $100 to $150 per hour, paid separately), or guests may bring their own qualified captain.
- Fuel is a flat $50 per charter, invoiced after the trip.

## Crewed experiences (we run the trip; captain, crew, and fuel included)
- [Lake & River Architecture Tour](https://lanchaboat.com/experiences/#architecture-tour): about 3.5 hours, private. Starts at Diversey Harbor, runs along the Lincoln Park lakefront and past the Playpen, then the full Chicago River architecture route through the locks twice, with a pass by Monroe Harbor when time allows. Guided by Kenny, a Chicago tour guide with ten years of experience. From $750 for the boat.
- [Sunset Cruise](https://lanchaboat.com/experiences/#sunset-cruise): about 2.5 hours, departing about 90 minutes before that day's sunset. From $400 Sunday through Wednesday, higher Thursday through Saturday.
- [Soldier Field & Northerly Island Shuttle](https://lanchaboat.com/experiences/#soldier-field-shuttle): boat ride from Diversey Harbor to Burnham Harbor, a short walk from Soldier Field and the Northerly Island concert venue. From $350 there and $550 back.
- [Boat Relocation](https://lanchaboat.com/experiences/#relocation): Captain Luis moves your boat from any harbor to any marina in the Chicago area. $475 plus rideshare to and from the boat.

## Where we go
- [The Playpen](https://lanchaboat.com/where-we-go/playpen/): Chicago's boat-party anchorage off Ohio Street Beach, about 10 to 15 minutes from Diversey Harbor.
- [South Loop & Museum Campus](https://lanchaboat.com/where-we-go/south-loop/): the classic head-on view of the Chicago skyline.
- [Navy Pier](https://lanchaboat.com/where-we-go/navy-pier/): the pier from the water, plus summer fireworks.
- [Burnham Harbor & Northerly Island](https://lanchaboat.com/where-we-go/burnham/): calmer, protected water with skyline and Museum Campus views.
- [The Chicago River](https://lanchaboat.com/where-we-go/the-river/): calm-water architecture cruising through downtown.

## Other pages
- [Chicago Notice to Mariners](https://lanchaboat.com/notices/): current U.S. Coast Guard and Chicago Harbor Safety Committee notices filtered for Chicago waters, refreshed every 15 minutes. Free for any boater.
- [Crew](https://lanchaboat.com/crew/): the captains, guide, and deckhands.
